state:
Goal `core-metrics-and-4-more`, stage 2, per-member feature proofs. `Core\Metrics`, `Core\Mime`,
`Core\Net\Datagram` and `Core\Net\Datagram\Message` are done, and their group checks pass.
`Core\Net::connect`, `listen` and `bindDatagram` carry every proof. The only members still owed
are `Core\Net::connectLocal` and `listenLocal`, so `dossier-core-net` is the last red check of the
stage. The two local members have a platform problem, which the item below describes. Nothing is
blocked.

next.title: the dossier
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs`, `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`, the three proof READMEs, and the `core/Net/connectLocal/` and `core/Net/listenLocal/` directories under `docs/examples/`, `tests/hostile/` and `benches/members/`.

items.text: **`Core\Net::connectLocal` and `listenLocal`** — every proof except help, plus a Rust `covers:` marker on the path-grant test near `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:2292` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). The members are at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1422` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1452`. **This build has no Unix-domain transport on Windows** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1491`), so a working example prints something different on Windows than on Linux. Only a grant refusal prints the same on both, because the grant is checked before the transport. The proof runner has no platform directive, only `requires: unimplemented` (`tools/nv/proofs/run.ts:54`). Recommended: add a `// requires: unix` directive beside it (skip on Windows, at `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts:165` and `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts:227`), document it in the three proof READMEs, and bless under WSL. Then decide how the Windows perf gate treats a bench it skips. The hostile case can be all grant refusals and pass on both.

**Close the goal** — once `dossier-core-net` passes, the whole of stage 2 is green: run `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-metrics-and-4-more` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-metrics-and-4-more`, then write `DONE` (`docs/agent/goals/core-metrics-and-4-more.md`, anchored at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:1422`).

backlog: The `Core\Net\Datagram` and `Message` reference cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs` are in the essay voice, not the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads* — goal `plain-comments` owns that sweep.
`docs/perf/members.ndjson` keeps two early `0.0` ns/op rows for `Core\Net\Datagram::receive` and the three `Message` members. The later `--force` rows replace them for every reader.
